intent: Rebind the already independently verified Arena and Helm CLOSED_NOT_PROD convergence plus the bounded Titanium/Sovereign-Safety effect-boundary admission to exact current main after unrelated test-only drift. No effect implementation, runtime restart, deployment, or worktree cleanup is claimed by this packet.

honest_blockers: This governance packet grants no runtime implementation authority until merged and a new exact implementation packet is rebound to the merged main SHA.
Worktree removal remains operator-gated after preservation proofs and is not performed here.
Runtime restart and deployed-SHA activation remain operator-only if they could terminate the active agent session.
interface_mismatches: Current main still declares Arena and Helm ACTIVE although their bounded control machinery and named implementation anchors are on main; they must close as CLOSED_NOT_PROD because the base entries retain blocker history.
check_track_status exports DHARMA_PYTHON into all command_passes environments, while the terminal suite uses that variable as a bridge executable and can be falsely red under the checker.

Humming V2 names a constitutional effect boundary as unowned while semantic_governance.ActionEnvelope already names a separate semantic-evaluation input; runtime types must remain distinctly named and explicitly bridged.
Only two default paths carry RuntimeWarrant; the admitted implementation must raise the count to at least five without creating a second store, ledger, registry, or receipt substrate.
session_entry.rollback: Revert the packet-scoped governance commit as one unit: restore Arena and Helm active entries, remove their closed entries and effect-boundary ownership/acknowledgement rows, restore the checker behavior, and regenerate managed projections from ACTIVE_TRACK.yaml.
